facts.fact: EVERSHAG 未预约就来到 KANDINSKY 狭小的办公室，没等邀请便推门进入；她的妆容因泪痕而花了，手里拿着一个牛皮纸信封。
facts.anchor: She dropped by KANDINSKY’s shoebox of an office unannounced, knocking on the door and quietly slipping in without waiting to be invited. Her makeup was a disaster from what looked like the trails of tears. She was carrying a manila envelope.

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 说她是来告诉 KANDINSKY 她恨她，随即改口说不恨，只是想像她一样，并说 KRAY 爱 KANDINSKY 而 KANDINSKY 也爱他。
facts.anchor: I came to tell you I hate you I mean I don’t really hate you I just want to be you you’re so smart and beautiful and KRAY loves you and you love him back

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 把信封递出，说里面是 KRAY 一直在找的东西——关于 GOOWIKI 计划的真相，是该计划从一开始就注定失败的骗局的证据，属绝密。
facts.anchor: It’s what KRAY has been looking for he’s braver than he knows he really wants to make the place better I hope he does it’s the truth the real truth about Project GOOWIKI it’s the proof that it’s all just a big fake program that was never meant to succeed from the start it’s TOP SECRET.

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 说她是为 Marla 才交出文件——那是在 Forward Operating Base ███████ 爆炸中死去的 Marla，KANDINSKY 的朋友，与来自西弗吉尼亚的 Eddie 订婚。
facts.anchor: The Marla who died in the bombing at Forward Operating Base ███████ the one you were friends with the one who was engaged to Eddie from West Virginia

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 说 Eddie 告诉她，不搜查那个人的主意是 Wacker 出的，这就是所有人都死了、包括 Marla 的原因。
facts.anchor: Eddie told me he heard it was Wacker’s idea not to search the guy and that’s why everybody died all of them including Marla

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 说 Marla 的全名是 Margelet，化名是 Cornelia D. ZOTZ。
facts.anchor: her full name was Margelet her pseudo was Cornelia D. ZOTZ

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 说 Marla 是她的姐妹，她欠姐姐这份情。
facts.anchor: Marla was my sister I owe her this

facts.fact: KANDINSKY 说 Marla 曾告诉她有个在这里工作的姐妹，但从没说过是 EVERSHAG，并一再为她的失去表示哀悼。
facts.anchor: Marla told me she had a sister who worked here, but she never said it was you. I am so, so sorry for your loss.
